title: Say Boses ya Ag-inmabobon ed Pakaandiay Ilalo
intro: Onloob ed sankaabungan ya say pakaandi et ontumbok ed pakaandi, balet ta sakey a kalmadon boses so ag-ontutundan manandi. Say sakey a tawag ed Qur'an et manggawa ed anos ya sakey a punto na pananguman; sarag mo kasin tumboken iray pakapatnagan ed samay toon walad benegan na satan a boses?
clues: Siak so boses na anos ed loob na sankaabungan ya saray bendisyon et nasubok ed kalamidad.
Nansiansia ak ed sankaabungan ya anggapoy karga to lapud inkaandi na kayamanan tan ananak.
Amtak ya walay sakit to met ed samay kaibak, ya say laman to et asakitan.
Nen linmoor so gonigon, tinmawag ak tekep na panonot ed si Allah.
Sakey so imbagak: Si Allah so katuaan, kanian mansiansian maanos.
Tinawag ko si Ayyub ed ngaran to; kayari to, inekal nen Allah so kairapan tan impawil toy pamilya.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say asawa nen Propeta Ayyub
Say Asawa nen Propeta Nuh
Say asawa nen Propeta Ibrahim
Say asawa nen Propeta Ya'qub
Say Anak a Bii nen Faraon

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Mansiansia ed si Ayyub legan na inkaandi tan sakit, insan onkerew na anos
Manpasakbay ed sakey a matunong a mensahero ya taynanan so sakey a kurakot a komunidad
Ipipikasi so kianak na arapen a kapolian
Mangipapatalos na kugip ed loob na prisoan na ari
Pananap na anak ya inmatalek ed gilig na ilog
trial.answer: Mansiansia ed si Ayyub legan na inkaandi tan sakit, insan onkerew na anos

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say pangibaga ya si Allah so Katuaan tan anos so nakaukolan
Sakey a kiew a palma ed abay na subol
Sakey a tawag ya manggawa na bapor ya arawi ed saray daluyon
Sakey a kugip na labin sakey a bitewen tan sakey ya onseselek ya agew
Sakey a baskit ya inawit ed gilig na Nilo
location.answer: Say pangibaga ya si Allah so Katuaan tan anos so nakaukolan

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Naekal so sakit nen Ayyub tan nipawil so pamilya to
Sakey ya abayag lan aalagaren ya anak so niiter kayari na ag-inkayadyari na pikakasi
Sakey a malangwer nin manuley so angipatalos ed pitoran taon na inkadaakan tan inkakulang
Sakey ya inmatalek ya ugaw so nisalba ed onaagus a danum
Sakey a pasakbay so akauna nen say makaderal a delap
outcome.answer: Naekal so sakit nen Ayyub tan nipawil so pamilya to

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
